# Required status checks on the `main` branch, in GitHub's context-name spelling.
#
# Branch protection is a repository setting, so it is not stored in the repo. This
# file is the reviewed source of truth for that setting: it names every context
# that must pass before a pull request can merge. `tests/test_release_integrity.py`
# derives the context names from `.github/workflows/unit-tests-workflow.yml` and
# fails when the two disagree, so a matrix change cannot silently leave a stale
# required context behind (GitHub would then report the old name as
# "Expected - Waiting for status to be reported" and block every pull request).
#
# After a change to the workflow's jobs or matrices, update this list and apply it:
#
#     uv run python scripts/sync_required_checks.py --apply
#
# The script reads this file, shows the difference against the live setting, and
# verifies the result by reading the setting back. It needs a token that can write
# branch protection, which means admin on the repository; the `repo` scope on a
# repository the user owns is enough.
#
# A job with a matrix reports one context per leg, named `<job> (<python>, <os>)`.
# A job without a matrix reports a context named `<job>`.
#
# Do not add `test-full`. It has `if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'`, reports
# `skipped` on pull requests, and would block every pull request forever.
# `docs`, `validation`, and `meta` do report, but they are deliberately optional.
